data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3000 experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 36.036 million in 2019, representing 2.93% of its opening gross reserves. This adverse development primarily stemmed from higher than expected losses on the 2018 and prior years of account. Contributing factors included losses from business lines that were exited (Property Open Market) or re-underwritten (Marine Hull and Cargo). Natural catastrophe events from 2016 (Alberta wildfires, Hurricane Matthew), 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquake, California wildfires), and 2018 (California wildfires, Hurricanes Florence, Michael) had previously impacted the underwriting results of those years, contributing to the adverse development observed in 2019.
